claims.statement: Meta documents a System User Access Token, generated in Business settings for a system user, that lets an app take automated actions on Ad objects or Pages without an app user or re-authentication.

sources.supports: System User access tokens let your app perform programmatic, automated actions on Ad objects or Pages without requiring input from an app user or re-authentication.
sources.locator: Access Tokens for Meta Technologies, System User Access Tokens

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Only existence is established. The access-tokens page states that token length changes over time and gives no format grammar; it is not recorded here.
